summary: @ornikar/commitlint-config 8.3.4 drops Bun runtime at preinstall to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs (itself obfuscated with control-flow tables and `_0x`-prefixed identifiers) downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary, sets it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line bundle beginning `// @bun @bun-cjs` with hex-obfuscated identifiers, a shuffled numeric/string array, and an array-rotation decoder function (WV8StW). The package's declared purpose is a commitlint configuration whose historical upstream index.js is a five-line `extends` ruleset; shipping an alternate runtime and a large opaque payload executed at install time is inconsistent with that purpose. The dropper chain runs automatically on `npm install` and executes attacker-controlled code under a runtime chosen to bypass Node-based analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
